units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 7:2">Sabb. VII, 2</cite> (among the labors forbidden on the Sabbath) <he>הקוֹצֵר</he> cutting plants. Ib. 73ᵇ <he>משום קוצר</he> as an act coming under the category of reaping.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 4:8">Pes. IV, 8</cite> <he>קוֹצְרִין וגודשין וכ׳</he> they reaped (the barley) and piled it before the ʿOmer was offered.
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 2:7">Peah II, 7</cite> <he>שדה שקְצָרוּהָ וכ׳</he> a field which gentiles reaped (for themselves) or which robbers reaped.
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 2:8">Ib. 8</cite> <he>נותן … שק׳</he> he must give up the poor man’s share from what he reaped.
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 3:6">Ib. III, 6</cite> <he>כדי לִקְצוֹר ולשנות</he> large enough for cutting (swinging the sickle) once and a second time; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (with נפש) to be impatient, vexed; to be sick of.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 52:12">Gen. R. s. 52</cite> <he>אבל היא לא קָצְרָה נפשה וכ׳</he> but she was not vexed (did not suffer from unsatisfied desire) &c.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 5:8:2">Y. Keth. V, 30ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 70:10">Yalk. Jud. 70</cite>. Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 19 <he>קצרה נפשם בדרך</he> they were sick of marching.

<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:4">Ber. I, 4</cite> <he>מקום … לקַצֵּר וכ׳</he> where they prescribed a lengthy benediction, one is not permitted to shorten, where they prescribed a short formula &c. Y. Yoma VI, beg. 43ᵇ <he>שלא יהא … קַצֵּר</he> (<cite ref="B00000"><he>ב</he></cite>)<he>דבריך</he> not that one of the contestants be permitted to speak as long as he needs, and the other be told, make thy speech brief; Y. Snh. III, 21ᶜ top.

<cite ref="Berakhot 34a:12">Ber. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>היה מְקַצֵּר וכ׳</he> gave a very brief prayer. Mekh. B’shall., Vayassʿa, s. 1 <he>ק׳</he> (<cite ref="B00000"><he>ב</he></cite>)<he>ברכותיו</he> gave short benedictions (prayers); <he>לא ק׳ … ממשה</he> he was not briefer than Moses (in his prayer, <cite ref="Numbers 12:13">Num. XII, 13</cite>).
<cite ref="Numbers 12:13">Ib.</cite> <he>יש שעה לְקַצֵּר וכ׳</he> there is a time to be brief &c.; a. fr.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 21:1">Lev. R. s. 21</cite> <he>היו … מִתְקַצְּרוֹת</he> their years (of life) were shortened.

senses.gloss: (with נפש) to be impatient, sick. Tanḥ. l. c. נִתְקַצְּרָה נפש העם בדרך (not נתקצר), v. supra.
